title: Excellent Idea but Terrible Practice
body: This app’s idea and goal is perfect. The thing I need for many years I can say. But the experience ruined everything. As first there are too many bugs and bad control options. As second we don’t have another language options like Turkish. As third, guys did you lost your mind? 500-800₺ per year? Premium subscription is too much expensive. As result: Another soul for app graveyard.
